name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. This ensures keyboard users see a clear, high-contrast target on all devices, including touchscreens where fat fingers need space. The trade-off is slightly larger rings on reduced-motion systems, but that’s acceptable because visibility trumps minimalism for accessibility.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2 requires 3px at 4.5:1 for those users. Better alternative: use 3px at 4.5:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and 4px at 7:1 otherwise. Settle with a live keyboard nav test on a high-contrast, reduced-motion device.
